Jehovah.{H3068} 12 As an oblation{H7133} of [first- fruits]{H7225} ye shall offer{H7126} them unto Jehovah:{H3068} but they shall not come up{H5927} for a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} on the altar.{H4196} 13 And every oblation{H7133} of thy meal-offering{H4503} shalt thou season{H4414} with salt;{H4417} neither shalt thou suffer the salt{H4417} of the covenant{H1285} of thy God{H430} to be lacking{H7673} from thy meal-offering:{H4503} with all thine oblations{H7133} thou shalt offer{H7126} salt.{H4417} 14 And if thou offer{H7126} a meal-offering{H4503} of first-fruits{H1061} unto Jehovah,{H3068} thou shalt offer{H7126} for the meal-offering{H4503} of thy first-fruits{H1061} grain in the ear{H24} parched{H7033} with fire,{H784} bruised{H1643} grain of the fresh ear.{H3759} 15 And thou shalt put{H5414} oil{H8081} upon it, and lay{H7760} frankincense{H3828} thereon: it is a meal-offering.{H4503} 16 And the priest{H3548} shall burn{H6999} the memorial{H234} of it, part of the bruised grain{H1643} thereof, and part of the oil{H8081} thereof, with all the frankincense{H3828} thereof: it is an offering made by fire{H801} unto Jehovah.{H3068}
